quarterly_data.quarter: Nautilus Biotechnology press release: Nature Methods Publication Reveals Deep Insights into (09-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nature Methods study results: specific tau modifications co-occurred far more often than predicted by chance, which the company says suggests tau is modified in an ordered, non-random sequence, with some proteoforms carrying as many as six phosphorylation modifications on one molecule; across a small human cohort of five ADRD patients and two cognitively normal individuals the assay resolved distinct tau proteoform profiles, and the patient with the most severe pathology carried the most heavily phosphorylated tau, including 1N3R tau quadruply phosphorylated at pT181-pT217-pT231-pS396, which the company says could become a biomarker or drug target.
quarterly_data.figure: five ADRD patients and two cognitively normal individuals; up to six phosphorylations per molecule
